title: Christ Church Cathedral (Fredericton)

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation sampled just outside the mapped western nave wall.

mapIdentity.scope: The mapped 34-point cathedral outline supplies the net outer walls, with native roof parts recording the nave and sanctuary axes and the exact octagonal spire footprint.

note: The cathedral records the current spire at 198 feet, equivalent to 60.35 m. Ground is sampled from the frozen west approach. Mapped component heights and the released exact photo guide the wall-to-roof proportions.
